author: Dark_Arkham
body: So I was playing Avicus today and all I said was "kys" on the chat and that got me banned by VennyMouse. I never knew staff are so butthurt after saying one word and when I mean 1 word, i literally mean i only said "kys" and I got banned for 2 weeks LMAO.

title: Banned for saying a word once

replies.author: VenomousViper
replies.body:
Hey,

I moved your post to "Appeal an Infraction" as this is the proper place for it. As far as your infraction goes we have strict no Death Threats/Suicide Encouragement rule (Rule A9 on the rules page). This appeal is denied. I'll leave this open for 24 hours if you have any questions/concerns. 

-Venny
